title: Planning
chooseBody: Read Markdown and design images where they already live. Atlas does not move or edit these files.
limits: Atlas notices files that change after you open the folder. It does not check earlier changes, files shared with other paths, or secrets inside documents.
browserUnavailable: Planning folders are available only in the macOS app.
empty: No supported documents or images were found.
observationLimit: Files may change before the next check.
findFile: Find a file name or path
historyLimit: Commit history shows the current branch's commits, without uncommitted changes.
comparisonLimit: Code comparison checks the whole repository at the start and end of the period, not each commit.
noMatches: No matching files. Change or clear the search.
partial: Some files or folders were not checked.
folderUnavailable: This folder is unavailable or has changed. Choose it again.
fileChanged: This file changed while you were reading. Refresh to read it again.
fileUnavailable: This file cannot be read now. Refresh or choose another file.
imageUnavailable: This image could not be displayed.
unsupported: This file cannot be displayed here.
noContentSearch: Search matches file and folder names, not file contents.
depthLimit: Some folders exceed the depth limit.
unknownRemaining: The number of unchecked entries is unknown.
unreadable: Entries that could not be checked: {count}
imageLimit: Some images exceed the document preview limit.
checkingSlow: This check is taking longer than expected. Use Refresh folder to try again.
startBody: Open a planning folder to read Markdown documents and design images in one place.
